cases.name: Frozen entry and release identity
cases.oracle: P20 signed closure and merge ancestry remain valid; version/platform/toolchain and normative sources fixed.

cases.name: Eight native binaries
cases.oracle: Exactly eight service binaries plus declared non-daemon helpers; version/commit JSON works without credentials or startup; ELF machine and static linkage verified.

cases.name: Static frontend
cases.oracle: All four compiled app outputs and required public assets; no source-only or build-host dependencies; PHP token assets packaged.

cases.name: Immutable migration catalog
cases.oracle: Every numbered migration unique/contiguous, original bytes and SHA256 retained; explicit backup/restore rollback boundary.

cases.name: Empty database and migration locking
cases.oracle: All migrations apply to native empty MySQL8; global lock, durable journal, checksum drift rejection and partial-DDL failure recovery tested.

cases.name: Package allowlist and clean extraction
cases.oracle: Deterministic archive with exact allowlist; no traversal, symlinks, devices, duplicate paths, Docker/Compose, Node runtime, node_modules or credentials.

cases.name: Checksum manifest and SBOM
cases.oracle: Every archive member accounted for; SHA256 and dependency SBOM match binaries/static outputs; tampering and missing files rejected.

cases.name: Native configuration
cases.oracle: Eight independent non-root systemd units, environment files, tmpfiles/logrotate and Nginx/PHP/static/proxy configuration render and validate.

cases.name: Installer access and state
cases.oracle: All eight IA INSTALL routes, private scoped session, CSRF, sequential durable state, secret redaction, noindex and post-lock404; existing design preserved.

cases.name: Mandatory dependency preflight
cases.oracle: Individually reject absent/unhealthy/wrong Nginx, PHP8.3, MySQL8, Redis, systemd, ClamAV, package integrity and local-storage permissions.

cases.name: Site and initial administrator
cases.oracle: Validate URL/TLS/storage conflicts and protected initial administrator creation through inherited Admin authority; no public privilege escalation.

cases.name: Privileged apply boundary
cases.oracle: PHP cannot run arbitrary root commands; root-owned worker consumes validated sealed request; serializes apply and preserves least privilege.

cases.name: Services health and lock
cases.oracle: Eight enable/start outcomes and DB/cache/storage/ClamAV/Nginx/HTTP health must pass before atomic installer lock; partial failures never report complete.

cases.name: Native upgrade and rollback
cases.oracle: Verified package switch and configuration reload with backup/restore boundary; interrupted/failed migration or service start recovers safely; never binary-only rollback across incompatible schema.

cases.name: Runbooks and support boundary
cases.oracle: Native install/operations/upgrade/restore runbooks executable and consistent with package; supported platform explicit; no production Docker or Node dependency.

cases.name: Installer browser verification
cases.oracle: Desktop/mobile routes and success/error/progress/locked states; keyboard/accessibility, console and server-side authorization evidence.

cases.name: Immutable candidate and G11
cases.oracle: All cases and affected regression exact-head PASS; archive digest fixed, inventory/eight versions/checksum/SBOM and G1/G11 evidence complete; no P22 claim.

cases.name: Accountable closure
cases.oracle: Pending until complete verified evidence and technical review; review-only signed child binds immutable package source/digest without rebuilding or changing payload; final regression and provenance required.
